'''Joshua''' is a deceased quest exclusive NPC that appears in {{Quest|The Eternal Concert}} as a [[Retroact Rain]] phantom.

==Profile==
He was a well-known pianist and the mentor of [[Arin]]. Twenty years prior to the start of [[Wuthering Waves]], he sacrificed his life to save [[Siran]] after a [[Tacet Discord]] attack during his performance at the outdoor theater on [[Nostalgia Isle]].
